result:
I'd remove the gap between what people know is right and what they feel compelled to do.

If people could actually feel, even for a moment, the weight of the consequences of their choices on someone else — not just understand it intellectually, but feel it — most cruelty, exploitation and short-sighted destruction would become unthinkable. Not because of rules, but because empathy would be the default.

Everything else gets easier from there.
